verdict.rationale: Azure documents its own building blocks for least-privilege credentials. Azure RBAC provides fine-grained access management scoped to specific resources (e.g., one identity manages VMs, another manages networks). Managed identities let workloads obtain Entra tokens without handling secrets, and client applications can be registered with Entra ID to secure REST calls. Together these let a user give an agent its own narrowly scoped identity. missing for 10: explicit documentation linking a service principal or app credential to a scoped role assignment, credential expiry/rotation details, agent-specific guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
